MINUTES
  ADJOURNED PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  JANUARY 16, 2018
An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called
to order at 7:00 p.m. in the City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North,
Rolling Hills Estates, California by VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance

3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Romanelli, Retz, Giglia, Persichina, Portugal

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Chair Pope, Wroan

  STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF DECEMBER 18, 2017

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER GIGLIA

  TO APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF DECEMBER
  18, 2017.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI so moved.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  NONE

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  ROLLING HILLS COUNTRY  CLUB  ESTATES  HOA  STREET  ENTRYWAY
  PROJECT REVISIONS

  Community Services Director Clark stated that Suzy Seamans was unable to attend the meeting
  to present this item. She has requested that this item be tabled to the Park and Activities
  Commission meeting of March 19, 2018.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI so ordered.

  B.  MARINE MAMMAL MOBILE EXHIBIT REQUEST

  Community Services Director Clark presented the staff report for the request for a mobile Marine
  Mammal Exhibit and stated that staff recommends that the Park and Activities Commission
  approve the periodic placement of the Marine Mammal Care Center, Los Angeles (MMCCLA)
  Mobile Visitors Center on the former Community Center site with the PVP Land Conservancy’s
  operation of the George F Canyon Nature Center.

  VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI inquired about sufficient space for visitor parking. Community Services
  Director Clark stated that there will be sufficient parking for visitors since the Community Center will
  be demolished and the mobile exhibit may be parked on the Community Center site leaving
  existing number of parking spaces available for visitors.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER RETZ, Community Services Director Clark stated
  that the frequency of the mobile exhibit has not been determined; they will rotate with White Point
  and the Nature Center in San Pedro. In addition, Community Services Director Clark assured
  COMMISSIONER RETZ that the MMCCLA will provide insurance coverage to the City.

  1
   COMMISSIONER RETZ asked about how this exhibit will be promoted throughout the City.
  Community Services Director Clark stated that the MMCLA will be promoting the event throughout
  the City and to the schools. COMMISSIONER RETZ suggested that staff provide information on
  this event to the HOA’s so that the information may be included in HOA newsletters.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER PORTUGAL,

  TO APPROVE THE REQUEST FOR A MOBILE MARINE MAMMAL EXHIBIT WITH THE
  CONDITION THAT THE MMCLA PROVIDE INSURANCE AS REQUIRED BY THE CITY.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI so moved.

  C.  COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS

  The Park and Activities Commissioners agreed to the following Committee, Subcommittee, and
  Adopt-A-Park assignments for 2018:

  Committees:
  Equestrian Committee  Commissioner Persichina

  Traffic and Safety Committee  Commissioner Giglia

  Environmental Advisory Committee Commissioner Retz

  Subcommittees:

  Tracy Austin Doubles Tennis
  Tournament Subcommittee  Commissioners Giglia and Romanelli

  The Hills are Alive Race
  Subcommittee  Commissioners Persichina, Pope, Romanelli, and Giglia

  City Celebration Subcommittee  Giglia, Pope, and Portugal

  Youth Sports Subcommittee  Giglia and Persichina

  Adopt-A-Park Assignments:

  Same as 2017

8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORT

  COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that on Palos Verdes Drive East (next to the golf course), there
  are loose fence rails. Community Services Director Clark stated that he will notify the Planning
  Department since the maintenance is responsibility of the gold course.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that on the trail from Palos Verdes Drive East towards June’s trail,
  the last rains caused quite a bit of erosion. He suggested the installation of cross beams to help
  with the drainage issues. Community Services Director Clark stated that the City is aware of the
  issue, and although some progress has been made, he will notify staff.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that there are a few/small tree limbs down at Chandler Park. He
  stated that there are also tree limbs down a Howlett Park and the marquee at the entrance is down
  as well. Community Services Director Clark stated that the posts will be repaired in order to
  reinstall the marquee. COMMISSIONER GIGLIA stated that vector control is working on clearing
  the leaves from the drain channels. Community Services Director stated that staff is working on a
  bid to re-do the trail and the drain channels.

  VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI stated that Rockbluff Park looks good and the new vinyl fencing is
  installed and looks good.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA asked about tryouts at Ernie Howlett Park. Community Services
  Director Clark stated that tryouts should be starting soon.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES  2
COMMISSION MINUTES
JANUARY 16, 2018
 9.  DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (Verbal Reports)

  A.  SBCCOG ANNUAL GENERAL ASSEMBLY – FEBRUARY 23, 2018

  Community Services Director Clark reported that the SBCCOG Annual General Assembly is
  coming up and will be held at the City of Carson Community Center. Park and Activities
  Commissioner’s interested in attending may register online.

  B.  PENINSULA HIGH SCHOOL WALK FOR LIFE – FEBRUARY 15, 2018

  Community Services Director Clark reported that the Peninsula High School Walk for Life is
  coming up and fundraising proceeds will go towards cancer research.

  C.  PARADE SUBCOMMITTEE DEBRIEFING MEETING – FEBRUARY 20, 2018

  Community Services Director Clark stated that the Parade Subcommittee Debriefing meeting will
  be held on February 20th at 6:00 p.m.
  D.  NEXT COMMISSION MEETING – TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 20, 2018

  Community Services Director Clark stated that the next Park and Activities will be moved to
  Tuesday, February 20, 2018 due to the observance of President’s Day.

10.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF DECEMBER 12, 2017

  B.  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE DRAFT MINUTES OF DECEMBER 18, 2017

  VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI stated that at the debriefing meeting there was mention of moving the
  Equestrian activities away from the City Celebration. Community Services Director Clark stated
  that there was no support for this suggestion.

  The matters of information above were received and filed.

11.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  NONE

12  ADJOURNMENT

  VICE CHAIR ROMANELLI adjourned the meeting at 7:27 p.m. to the next meeting of the Park and
  Activities Commission scheduled for Tuesday, February 20, 2018 beginning at 7:00 p.m. in the
  Council Chamber at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
  Estates, California.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  Carol Corea  Andy Clark
  Administrative Assistant  Community Services Director
